from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        res_label = Text("Result", color=COLOR_RESULT, font_size=24)
        
        # Labels at C2, C4, C6
        self.place_at_grid(base_label, "C2")
        self.place_at_grid(exp_label, "C4")
        self.place_at_grid(res_label, "C6")
        
        # Base Circle (as per storyboard)
        base_circle = Circle(radius=0.3, color=COLOR_BASE, fill_opacity=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(base_circle, "D2")

        fruit_stem = Line(ORIGIN, UP*0.2, color="#228B22").next_to(fruit_main, UP, buff=0)
        fruit_icon = VGroup(fruit_main, fruit_stem)
        self.place_at_grid(fruit_icon, "D6")
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(base_label), FadeIn(exp_label), FadeIn(res_label),
            FadeIn(base_circle), FadeIn(exp_symbol), FadeIn(fruit_icon)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # The Base is the value we are multiplying.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_BASE)
        )
        self.play(base_circle.animate.scale(1.2).set_stroke(width=8), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(base_circle.animate.scale(1/1.2).set_stroke(width=4), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # The Exponent counts how many times we multiply it.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_EXPONENT)
        )
        
        # Create copies of base_circle to represent multiplying
        copy1 = base_circle.copy()
        copy2 = base_circle.copy()
        copy3 = base_circle.copy()
        
        # Arrange copies around the exponent symbol
        copies = VGroup(copy1, copy2, copy3).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(copies, "D4", scale_factor=0.6)
        
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(base_circle, copies),
            exp_symbol.animate.scale(1.2).set_color(YELLOW),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Transform the multiplied circles into the purple giant fruit icon
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(copies, fruit_icon),
            exp_symbol.animate.scale(1/1.2).set_color(COLOR_EXPONENT),
            fruit_icon.animate.scale(1.3),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(fruit_icon.animate.scale(1/1.3))
        
        self.wait(2)
